build.buildCommand: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && python -m pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdir -p /app/easyocr_models && EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR=/app/easyocr_models python download_ocr_models.py

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'export PATH="/root/.nix-profile/bin:/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH"; export EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR="${EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR:-/app/easyocr_models}"; export TESSERACT_CMD="${TESSERACT_CMD:-$(which tesseract 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/tesseract)}"; if [ "${SERVICE_ROLE:-web}" = "worker" ]; then exec python worker.py; else exec gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py app:app; fi'
